# ADSABSClient v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

A fully-featured, production-ready Elixir client for the SAO/NASA Astrophysics Data System (ADS) API v2.

## Pages

- [ADSABSClient](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- Core
  - [ADSABSClient](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.md): A fully-featured Elixir client for the SAO/NASA Astrophysics Data System (ADS) API v1.
  - [ADSABSClient.Application](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Application.md): OTP Application entry point for ADSABSClient.
  - [ADSABSClient.Config](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Config.md): Configuration validation and access for ADSABSClient.

- HTTP
  - [ADSABSClient.HTTP](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.HTTP.md): Core HTTP client for ADSABSClient.
  - [ADSABSClient.HTTP.Behaviour](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.HTTP.Behaviour.md): Behaviour contract for the ADSABSClient HTTP layer.

- APIs
  - [ADSABSClient.Accounts](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Accounts.md): ADS Accounts API — token validation and rate limit status.
  - [ADSABSClient.CitationHelper](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.CitationHelper.md): ADS Citation Helper API — `/citation_helper`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Export](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Export.md): ADS Export API — `/export/:format`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Feedback](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Feedback.md): ADS User Feedback API — `/feedback/userfeedback`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Journals](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Journals.md): ADS Journals API — `/journals/*`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Libraries](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Libraries.md): ADS Libraries API — `/biblib/*`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Metrics](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Metrics.md): ADS Metrics API — `/metrics`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Objects](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Objects.md): ADS Objects API — `/objects/*`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Oracle](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Oracle.md): ADS Oracle API — `/oracle/*`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Resolver](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Resolver.md): ADS Resolver API — `/resolver/:bibcode`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Search](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Search.md): ADS Search API — `/search/query` and `/search/bigquery`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Vis](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Vis.md): ADS Visualization API — `/vis/*`.

- Query Building
  - [ADSABSClient.Query](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Query.md): Composable Solr query builder for the ADS Search API.

- Pagination &amp; Concurrency
  - [ADSABSClient.Async](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Async.md): Helpers for concurrent ADS API requests using `Task.async_stream/3`.
  - [ADSABSClient.Pagination](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Pagination.md): Pagination helpers for ADS Search API results.

- Types
  - [ADSABSClient.Error](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Error.md): Structured error type for all ADSABSClient operations.
  - [ADSABSClient.Libraries.Library](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Libraries.Library.md): Struct representing an ADS private library.

  - [ADSABSClient.Metrics.Response](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Metrics.Response.md): Typed struct for ADS Metrics API responses.

  - [ADSABSClient.RateLimitInfo](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.RateLimitInfo.md): Parsed rate-limit metadata from ADS API response headers.
  - [ADSABSClient.Search.Response](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Search.Response.md): Typed struct for ADS Search API responses.

- Telemetry
  - [ADSABSClient.Telemetry](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events emitted by ADSABSClient.

- Rate Limiting
  - [ADSABSClient.RateLimiter](https://adsabs-client.hexdocs.pm/ADSABSClient.RateLimiter.md): GenServer that tracks rate-limit state across all requests.
